column1: # Indonesian sentiment lexicon, authored for this package (MIT). One word per line: word<TAB>valence.
# Valence scale as VADER: -4..4; anchors +-0.5 faint, +-1.5 mild, +-2.5 clear, +-3.5 extreme.
# No neutral entries and no negation or booster words, except the dual-role words `parah` and `lumayan`.
# Never copy from other lexicons (InSet, SentiStrength-ID and Kamus Alay carry no license).
